description: This PHP source file defines a custom exception class ConfigNotFoundException within the OrangeHRM ORM exception namespace. It extends the base Exception class and provides a static method to generate a specific 'not installed' exception message.

classes.name: ConfigNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating a configuration or installation failure within the ORM subsystem.

methods.name: notInstalled
methods.description: A static method that returns an instance of ConfigNotFoundException with a message indicating that the application is not installed.
